verdict.rationale: Workable lists a custom report builder on its pricing page. It also documents a REST API with read endpoints for jobs, candidates, events, requisitions, stages and offers, plus webhook subscriptions, which an analyst could use to pull raw recruiting data into a warehouse. However, nothing documents report-level export or a dedicated reporting API, and the report builder is only a one-line pricing mention. Missing for 10: scheduled report exports, BI/warehouse connectors, a dedicated reporting/analytics API, detailed report-builder documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse
